description: The Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct demo kit: everything the loom needs beside the model weights. Every asset is sha256-pinned; tools/fetch_kit.py verifies each before use.

assets.name: loom_map_v1a_r64.npz
assets.description: The kit's v1a map (the served 8B map re-exported by `pleroma export`: canonical SVD signs, in-build shelf stats): rank-64 codes -> per-site residual levers at sites 9/17/21/25, with its ruler (norm_ref).

assets.name: loom_map_v1a_r64.npz.doseband.json
assets.description: The map's MEASURED dose band (uniform injection span): below blind detection <= 0.35, threshold (0.35, 1.0), overdriven >= 1.0 (lever-dependent damage, measured). Stamped with the map's fingerprint and ruler; the server finds it beside the map.

assets.name: factor_directions_8b.npz
assets.description: The frozen feature space the map was fit in (feature names + standardisation); the map refuses any other.

assets.name: calib_8b_positional_means.npz
assets.description: Per-position, per-layer residual means for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (anamnesis calibration), filled through position 2047. Rows 0-554 are the calibration the map was fit under, byte for byte; rows 555-2047 are a fresh fit by the same recipe (generation continued past end-of-turn), spliced on.

assets.name: calib_8b_pca_model.pkl
assets.description: The calibration's residual-stream PCA (a pickle: load only after its sha256 verified).

assets.name: v1a_report.json
assets.description: The registered cross-validation report (held-out within-fan retrieval vs the shelf baseline) for pleroma validate's fit gates.

assets.name: loom_map_v1a_r64_export_report.json
assets.description: The export's self-check report for this map file, for pleroma validate's export-report gate.
